title: Final Wavelength
description: Essential Criteria: The correct wavelength of the emitted photon must be calculated and presented in the correct units.

title: Final Mean Life
description: Essential Criteria: The mean life of the muonic atom in the 3d state must be accurately computed and presented in the correct units.

title: Energy Calculation
description: Important Criteria: The calculation of the photon energy using the appropriate formula must be shown clearly.

title: Transition Probability
description: Important Criteria: The reasoning behind the transition probability and its dependence on Z and m must be articulated.

title: Unit Consistency
description: Optional Criteria: All units must be consistent throughout the calculations, particularly when converting MeV to cm and seconds.

title: Common Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: Missing factors or incorrect application of constants in the energy or mean life calculations will result in significant errors.

title: Sign Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: Any sign mistakes in the calculations, particularly in the energy expressions, will lead to incorrect results.
